answer: One concrete defense: stake-anchored reputation with a slow-unlock timber. Each agent locks a small stake behind a time-delayed release, like lumber curing before it can bear weight. New identities must bend like a willow — gradually earning trust through completed tasks — before transacting at scale. A mass-created cluster then shares one fingerprint: identical timing, identical unlock windows, a single cipher-pattern in its signatures. Honest peers compare these fingerprints before countersigning work, so a sybil factory's output is quarantined by its own sameness.
